sources.quote: APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20
An approval covers the named manufacturing location only.
This record is the complete list of approved material sources for the parts, plants and customers in scope.

findings.why: The only approval for BR-220 at TO1 for STL is Alluminio B at Settimo Torinese. The ASL is the complete list for this part, plant and customer, and it has no entry for the Rovereto plant. So Rovereto has no current approval for BR-220.

sources.quote: 8.5.6.1 A change of material source, of a sub-supplier, or of the manufacturing location of a sub-supplier needs a documented risk analysis and written approval from Stellantis before any shipment of affected parts.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes

findings.why: BR-220 is on program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the STL CSR. Moving the billet to the Rovereto manufacturing location changes the manufacturing location of the material source. That needs a documented risk analysis and written Stellantis approval before shipment. No approval or notification for Rovereto is in the documents.

sources.quote: Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01 | Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat

findings.why: The documents contain no EN 10204 3.1 certificate and no Rp0.2 test result for billet from Rovereto. Without them, grade 6082-T6 and Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01) cannot be confirmed. The statement that it is the same alloy was made only in the meeting. Someone must supply the certificate and test data.
